d:
A German mother wants her four-year-old son to move to Singapore. His Indian father contests the move. And the custody battle ends up before the Supreme Court.
The Supreme Court has now granted interim custody to the mother, allowing her to relocate the child for schooling while putting safeguards in place for the father's access.
What led to the case? Why did it travel from Goa to Kolkata to the Supreme Court? And what did the Court say about a child's welfare, jurisdictional disputes and parental conflict?
Ruchi Bhattar explains the Supreme Court's ruling in this cross-border custody battle.
